name: cloudflare
description: Cloudflare Worker deploy module (optional static assets, Durable Object, Container)
instructions: Add CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN to packages/infra/environments/<env>/secrets.yaml; set accountId in the instance config (not a secret). The Worker topology lives in the package's own wrangler.jsonc, which is the source of truth for it. For per-PR preview workers, set workerName (e.g. `zbc-<app>-pr-${process.env.PR_NUMBER}`) on the preview instance; use wranglerEnv to select a named `env.<name>` block in wrangler.jsonc instead. Container-backed Workers need Docker running locally at apply time and a Workers Paid plan with Containers enabled.
